source: Produced by running `python -m skyfuel all` (v1: synthetic OpenSky-shaped trajectories, OpenAP physics labels, TrendPlusResidual XGBoost) in a scratch copy of the repo on 2026-11-19, then querying the saved model with the same Explainer/what-if calls the Streamlit dashboard uses.
dataNote: Flights are SYNTHETIC (OpenSky-shaped generator, March 2025); fuel labels come from the OpenAP physics model, not airline data.
pipelineLog:
